definitions.explanation: Food prepared in the Japanese culinary tradition. A broad term encompassing everything from sushi and tempura to everyday home cooking.

examples.japanese: {日本食|にほんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{日本食|にほんしょく}⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese restaurants are increasing overseas as well.

examples.japanese: {日本食|にほんしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧、{健康的|けんこうてき}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese food is said to be healthy with good nutritional balance.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term for Japanese cuisine. Interchangeable with ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ in most contexts, though ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ tends to emphasize traditional dishes while {日本食|にほんしょく} can include modern Japanese cooking. Often contrasted with ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Western food) or ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧ (Chinese food).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本食|にほんしょく}⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧: Japanese restaurant
- {日本食|にほんしょく}⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧: Japanese food boom
- {日本食|にほんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: Japanese food culture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧: Japanese cuisine (emphasizes traditional style)
- ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧: Western-style food
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: cooking, cuisine (general)
